title: SmimeError::Other used for 'no signers' case — warrants MalformedInput variant
description: verify.rs line 109: Err(SmimeError::Other('no SignerInfo entries in SignedData')) — this is a malformed-input case distinct from an operation error. Callers cannot programmatically distinguish 'empty SignedData' from any other Other(String) error. The existing MIME-b5x.16 deferred issue covers the broader String-swallowing pattern. This specific case is common enough to deserve a variant like SmimeError::MalformedInput(String) or SmimeError::EmptySignedData.
